faqs.a: The classic meme style is uppercase, which is why the tool uppercases automatically. It is a stylistic choice of the format - your text is rendered in capitals by design.
Keep the punchline short: under 10 words per line reads best. The tool wraps automatically, but short captions hit harder and stay big.
faqs.q: How long should my meme text be?

faqs.a: Impact is the classic meme font. If it is not installed, the tool falls back to Arial Black, then Arial Narrow Bold, then a bold system font - always heavy and readable.
Drag the font size slider up to 120 pixels. If a line is still too long, the tool wraps it - but very long captions will always shrink in impact, so shorten them.
faqs.q: My text is too long and wraps a lot. What now?

meme-generator.formula:
font size on canvas = slider px x (image width / 600)
line height = font size x 1.15
top text starts 16 px from the top, bottom text 16 px from the bottom.
Example: 1200 px wide image, 48 px slider:
canvas font = 48 x (1200 / 600) = 96 px, line height = 110.4 px.

2. Line height = 96 x 1.15 = 110.4 px.
